key_insight: DanceOPD tackles a core image-generation bottleneck: different capabilities like text-to-image, local editing, and global editing often conflict when trained together. Its key breakthrough is learning these capabilities in a way that keeps them aligned, so one model can do all three without sacrificing quality.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the challenge of composing multiple image generation abilities in a single model. In practice, improving editing can hurt text-to-image generation, and global and local edits can interfere with each other, making unified training difficult.
method: Uses an on-policy generative field distillation strategy to better align training with the model’s own generated outputs.
Encourages compatibility between text-to-image generation, local editing, and global editing instead of optimizing each in isolation.
Reduces capability interference so the model can support multiple image-editing behaviors in one unified system.
impact: This matters because practitioners want one model that can generate and edit images reliably without needing separate specialized systems. A better unified training approach can simplify deployment, improve versatility, and reduce performance trade-offs.
